comparison.objective: Candidate recovers finishing media while retaining reusable metal workpieces; record removes sharps from a reusable surgical tray while retaining blunt instruments and staging the tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests bulk pouring, bimanual screening and orientation-dependent bridge clearing; record tests selective individual grasping, complete-device disposal and tray transport.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires ≥98% media recovery through the screen, every washer retained, no spill/contamination and released dwell; record requires two syringe/needle devices in a sharps bin, blunt instruments retained and tray placed and released in a target area.
comparison.reason: Both retain one class while relocating another, but the record tests semantic object-by-object segregation; the candidate tests physical size/orientation separation through apertures.
